class_rule: The class follows the 2005 rule: every player selected in the real draft (players_drafted, identity only) plus every player projected by at least one of the eight sources, by a numbered slot or by name in a source's unordered second-round group (InsideHoops, ranking_sources), who was eligible on draft night and was not selected (undrafted_candidates). Eligibility is the NBA's June 19, 2006 early-entry release as of the June 18 withdrawal deadline (37 college and 10 international candidates remaining, 47 withdrawn), plus college seniors and international players born on or before December 31, 1984, who were automatically eligible. Projected players who withdrew are listed under withdrawn_before_draft and are not in the pool. No high-school player was eligible in 2006.
